Emergency funds, in plain English 🌿

One surprise bill shouldn't wreck your month. Here's the simple version:

💷 First target: £500–£1,000 — a common starter goal that covers most surprises (car, boiler, vet).
📈 Then build: about 3 months of essential costs — rent, bills, food. A widely used rule of thumb, not a test you can fail.
🔁 Make it automatic: a standing order on payday — even £10 — beats willpower every time.

Give the fund its own name and track it monthly. One page is enough.
